premises.text: Private aviation is currently expensive and inaccessible to most people
premises.evidence_span: if I mention private aviation, you might be picturing those big private jets reserved to 500 fortunes executive or people drinking champagne

premises.text: Wingly connects private pilots with passengers to share flight costs
premises.evidence_span: Wingly makes private aviation accessible to everybody by connecting private pilots with passengers so they can share the cost of a flight

premises.text: Wingly offers a platform that simplifies the booking process for flights
premises.evidence_span: On Wingly, you can book a flight in only a few clicks

premises.text: Wingly Flight Request allows users to request flights from private pilots
premises.evidence_span: we're super happy to be introducing live on this stage the Wingly Flight Request

premises.text: Regulatory changes allow private pilots to share flight costs and advertise
premises.evidence_span: a 2016 regulatory change made it clear for private pilots that they're allowed to share the cost of a flight and also advertise it on light beforehand

premises.text: Wingly has developed a tailored insurance product for flights
premises.evidence_span: We developed a tailor-made insurance product that allow us to offer all our customers an extra 1 million euro coverage on all the flights you do

premises.text: The private aviation market is worth over 35 billion euros and has significant untapped potential
premises.evidence_span: the private aviation market. It's a market that's worth more than 35 billion euro

premises.text: Many private planes remain unused for over 70% of the time
premises.evidence_span: Private planes stay on the ground more than 70% of the time

premises.text: Wingly can reduce flight costs significantly for passengers
premises.evidence_span: thanks to Wingley, it's actually now only 100 euro per person

premises.text: Wingly has experienced significant growth in its community and flight offerings
premises.evidence_span: we managed to grow our community from 30,000 members to more than 150,000 members

value.text: Private aviation becomes more accessible and affordable for everyone
value.evidence_span: Wingly makes private aviation accessible to everybody by connecting private pilots with passengers so they can share the cost of a flight

notes: Traction metrics and fundraising details are excluded as they do not support premises.
